findings: CbctVolume3DViewport was performing 140 raymarching steps through empty air for every pixel on canvas
CbctVolume3DViewport re-rendered on every raw mousemove without RAF batching
reconstructPanoramicView allocated 8.14 million heap objects per frame due to nested worldMmToVoxelContinuous allocations
reconstructPanoramicView recomputed 2D arc distances and slab offsets repeatedly for every row (220x redundant computation)
reconstructPanoramicView was purely CPU-bound (175ms), locking UI thread during W/L and arch anchor scrubbing; GPU WebGL2 reconstruction reduces render time to <1ms
Intel UHD / Iris Xe / weak mobile GPUs could crash if CBCT volume exceeded gl.MAX_3D_TEXTURE_SIZE (e.g. 512) - resolved with automatic integer factor downsampling
4K / Retina screens caused fill-rate bottleneck on iGPUs - resolved with interactive resolution clamp (960x720 interactive, 1440x1080 idle)
GPU context loss was unhandled, causing permanent black viewport on GPU hang - resolved with e.preventDefault() and clean resource recreation
